boundaries.label: Proxies are the only network peers

cards.title: Scheduling 200 agents
items: Orders by job_id. It does not use a deadline.
Host cap 8, a per-tenant cap, and a 90 minute window
200 ten-minute jobs place 72 and escalate 128
A 429, or three provider errors, falls back to local
max_steps and wall_s are parsed and not enforced

cards.title: Sandbox
items: User 65534, read-only root, capabilities dropped, 64 MB noexec scratch
py.exec runs in the agent container. The proxy answers not_executed
The host repo is mounted read-only at /src
The run token is bound to the container IP and is not a credential
A cross-tenant mail.read is stored on the step as foreign_id

cards.title: Failure and resume
items: Step key: run, step number, hash of messages and tools
SUCCEEDED needs a last line cites: of ids in that tenant's mail or documents
A STARTED row 30 seconds old, or a newer generation, is taken over
That takeover can bill the provider twice. The ledger keeps one cost
Resume binds a new token and skips completed steps. The third resume escalates

cards.title: Tenants, evals, memory
items: One membership per user: viewer, approver or admin
Proxy tenant scope plus Postgres RLS; an unset tenant returns no rows
Evals: recorded cases, hard checks, temperature-0 judge, drop of 0.3 or less
The cursor is written on SUCCEEDED for a cited mail id. It is not read back
Panel (design only): three models, two rounds, minority view kept

cards.title: Drafts and approval
items: Agents write drafts and cannot send
send needs an approver in the same tenant
The SMTP log matches message_id, so a second deliver does not send
Domains come from the tenant row. External or attached drafts stay flagged

cards.title: Not building, and hardening
items: Not built: live connectors, web UI, OIDC, replica, panel
Shared kernel: no gVisor or microVMs; a kernel exploit could reach other tenants
Weakest part: the proxy holds the provider key, the tenant map, and the budget
1 Detect leaks: canary IDs and a fuzzer
2 Firecracker microVM per run from a warm pool
3 Vault and broker: five-minute, one-tenant tokens
4 Gateway, broker, ledger over mutual TLS, failing closed
5 Synchronous Postgres replica and lease fences
